title: Shipping Information
description: Learn about our shipping options, delivery areas, and shipping costs.
content:
# Shipping Information

PixelForge delivers gaming hardware and accessories to customers throughout Sweden.

## Shipping Options

We offer standard home delivery and delivery to selected pickup points. Available options are displayed during checkout.

## Shipping Costs

Standard shipping costs 69 SEK. Orders exceeding 1,500 SEK qualify for free standard shipping.

## Delivery Areas

We currently deliver within Sweden only. International shipping is not available.

## Important Information

Large products, including prebuilt gaming PCs, may require special handling and could have different delivery conditions.

title: Delivery Times
description: Find out how long your PixelForge order will take to arrive.
content:
# Delivery Times

Delivery times depend on product availability, order processing, and the selected shipping method.

## Standard Delivery

Products that are in stock are normally delivered within 2–4 business days after dispatch.

## Order Processing

Orders are generally processed within one business day. Orders placed during weekends or public holidays are processed on the next business day.

## Prebuilt Gaming PCs

Certain gaming PCs require additional preparation and testing before shipping. These orders may take 5–8 business days to arrive.

## Delays

Delivery times may be affected by holidays, high order volumes, or unexpected transportation issues. Customers will be notified if a significant delay occurs.

title: Order Tracking
description: Learn how to track your order and check its delivery status.
content:
# Order Tracking

Customers can follow the progress of their PixelForge orders using the tracking information provided after dispatch.

## Tracking Your Shipment

Once your order has been shipped, you will receive an email containing a tracking number and a link to the delivery provider.

## Order Status

Orders may have the following statuses:

- Processing: Your order is being prepared.
- Shipped: Your package has left our warehouse.
- In Transit: Your package is on its way.
- Delivered: Your package has reached its destination.

## Missing Tracking Information

Tracking information may take up to 24 hours to become available after dispatch.

## Contact Support

If your tracking information has not updated for several business days, please contact PixelForge customer support.
